errors.evidence: The description states that the x-axis scale is linear, but the tick marks (1%, 5%, 10%, 20%, 50%, 80%, 100%) are not spaced according to their numerical value, but rather are treated as ordered categories with equal spacing on the plot.
The description incorrectly states that the interval for the x-axis is 5%. The actual intervals between the tick marks are not constant (e.g., 5%-1%=4%, 10%-5%=5%, 20%-10%=10%).
The description claims the x-axis has no unit, but the labels clearly use the percentage symbol (%) as the unit.
